masterPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: painted 2D game character rig MASTER, single full body on pure #00FF00 green.
Input image: the approved Mouse Fighter standee, identity and style reference.
Redraw EXACTLY this hero at high resolution, same proportions and outfit: warm grey fur, enormous pink ears, cream muzzle, two brown eyes visible, red scarf, royal blue short tunic with gold edging, brown cross-body strap, gold-buckled brown belt and left hip pouch, short grey furry legs, brown open-toed boots with pink toes. Bold dark outlines, warm painted cel shading, upper-left lighting. No new costume details.
Pose: upright alert heroic game stance, three-quarter facing RIGHT about 30 degrees toward viewer, feet apart, knees only slightly bent. Keep his large head and compact stocky body. Near arm extends to LEFT of body, elbow slightly bent, brown gloved near hand holds sword angled upward LEFT, matching reference. Far arm extends RIGHT, far gloved hand clearly VISIBLE just inward of the existing oval gold-rim wood shield, shield positioned out to the RIGHT of the body so it hides no torso or leg. Both eyes and both hands visible. Near boot at left should point slightly RIGHT toward camera, never backwards. Pink tail curling behind him on left, scarf tails behind left shoulder. Mouth closed in a determined confident small smile.
Composition: 1536 x 2304 portrait canvas, character including sword about 1350 pixels tall, centered in lower middle, feet at y=2050, large blank green margins. A tiny short dark floor registration dash at far left and far right at y=2050, NOT underneath feet. No cast shadow, no floor, no text, no labels, no gradients in green. One character only. Preserve the standee identity closely.
bootPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact Mouse Fighter master. Change ONLY the near/front foot at the lower LEFT: turn its brown open-toed boot and pink toes to point toward the RIGHT and slightly toward the viewer, aligned like the far foot rather than pointing backward to the left. Keep ankle and shin position, floor height, leg thickness, same boot leather trim and toes. Do not change anything else: head, ears, face, scarf, torso, hands, weapons, other boot, tail, stance, canvas, background and scale remain identical. Flat #00FF00 background, no shadow.
jointPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is an actual CUT PARTS atlas from one approved game master, arranged FIVE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 17 occupied cells. Preserve every cell position, size and scale; do not rearrange. Paint ONLY the missing hidden joint material around cut edges, keeping visible artwork unchanged. Extend cut shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees, ankles and hips by about 25 pixels with ROUND caps and dark outlines; no flat chopped edges. Complete missing blue tunic upper shoulders and neckline in row1 col2; complete blue pelvis in row1 col3, removing incidental grey thigh slivers. Row1 col4 blue sleeve/cream furry upper arm; row1 col5 brown forearm leather bracer, remove gold sword contamination. Row2 col1 near brown gripping glove: complete wrist at RIGHT, remove red scarf and gold weapon scraps, retain EMPTY shaft hole. Row2 col2 far blue sleeve/cream upper arm; row2 col3 brown bracer with ROUND elbow/wrist, remove shield gold; row2 col4 far glove fist with full RIGHT edge and wrist at LEFT, remove gold shield. Row2 col5 grey thigh: complete rounded hidden hip and knee, remove blue hem. Row3 col1 brown shin boot upper, round both ankle and knee. Row3 col2 brown boot foot toes right, round hidden ankle at top. Row3 col3 grey far thigh rounded ends, remove blue tunic and boot scraps. Row3 col4 brown far shin, round ends. Row3 col5 brown far foot, round ankle. Row4 col1 pink tail complete round root at right. Row4 col2 two red scarf tail fragments: connect into one red scarf-tail with hidden red cloth behind the occluding hand, round root at top RIGHT. Row1 col1 head: remove stray pixels on left, complete hidden round grey neck under chin; do not change face or ears. Empty cells remain green. Keep strict FIVE COLUMN grid, same registration, pure #00FF00 background, 1536 square. No labels, weapons, bodies, shadows or new design.

jobs.name: back
jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: supplied Mouse Fighter master. Draw the SAME Mouse Fighter from BEHIND, matching proportions, large ears, grey fur, red scarf, blue tunic with gold trim, brown crossed back harness, gold fastener and belt and left hip pouch, brown boots with pink toes, pink tail. Same upright feet-apart stance and limb thickness, upper-left light, bold dark outline warm painted game art. No sword or shield so all arms and gloved hands visible. Exact pure #00FF00 flat background, no shadow, no text. Full body only, portrait 1024x1536. Keep scale and placement as supplied.

jobs.name: heads
jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input is exact character master. Make a cutout expression sheet of ONLY the SAME Mouse Fighter HEAD, no scarf, no neckwear, no body: enormous pink left ear, smaller right ear, warm grey fur, cream muzzle, same two brown eyes visible and pink nose, facing right in three-quarter view. Four separated heads in a 2x2 grid, identical size, proportions, ear silhouette and angle. Top left ATTACK shouting with mouth wide open and focused eyebrows; top right HURT eyes pinched shut mouth pained; bottom left EFFORT gritted visible teeth determined bracing brows; bottom right KO eyes shut and mouth slack. Preserve exact identity and painted bold dark outline style of reference. Pure #00FF00 background, generous green gaps, no shadow, no text, no labels, no other parts. Square sheet 1536x1536.

jobs.name: hands
jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference: Mouse Fighter master, preserve brown leather gloves and bold painted style. Draw ONLY six separate glove cutouts arranged 3 columns x 2 rows, each with round wrist cuff extension and same hand size. TOP ROW near right hand viewed from camera with wrist coming from RIGHT: open palm with five fingers pointing left; closed fist; gripping fist with thumb wrapping around an EMPTY vertical narrow shaft slot (pure green hole through center, 18% hand width). BOTTOM ROW far left glove with wrist coming from LEFT, same three variants: open palm fingers right; closed fist; grip with visible vertical shaft slot. Warm brown leather, gold stitching, dark outlines, upper-left lighting. No forearms, no weapons, no objects, no labels. Pure #00FF00 flat green background, ample gaps, square 1536x1536. Each fist is a compact fist like the master, not an oversized gauntlet.

jobs.name: support
jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Use supplied Mouse Fighter master as exact identity and style reference. Create a separated rig support sheet on pure flat #00FF00, bold dark outlines, upper-left light. 2 columns x 2 rows, no labels, no shadows. TOP LEFT: only his torso turned side-on facing RIGHT, red scarf, blue tunic gold trim, diagonal brown strap, belt gold buckle and pouch, complete tunic hem, rounded blue shoulder sockets, no head no arms no legs. TOP RIGHT: only his near arm raised VERTICALLY, whole arm from round blue sleeve shoulder at bottom to cream furry elbow, brown bracer and brown gripping gloved hand at top with green shaft slot. BOTTOM LEFT: only his far arm bent in raised shield GUARD, whole arm from blue sleeve shoulder at right to cream furry elbow at lower left to brown gloved fist at upper left gripping invisible shield strap; no shield, no weapon. BOTTOM RIGHT: torso FRONT three-quarter matching input exactly but with no arms, no head, complete scarf, tunic and belt and hem, including hidden blue cloth under where near upper arm overlaps. Do not redesign outfit or change glove/fur colors. All four images separated widely.
